# DD-75: World maps are generated by packages/content/world/tools/gen-maps

Status: binding under D-37 (designer may overrule).
Spec: 10.1, 10.2, R-WORLD-001, R-ART-004

## Decision

World maps are generated by packages/content/world/tools/gen-maps.ts (Tiled 1.10 JSON with one embedded tileset, tiles painted in code) and a test checks the checked-in files match; warps never land on a warp, NPC or grass tile and the return warp is next to the landing tile; challenge zones hold no grass or warps; every place is reachable from the start spawn without stepping on grass; new players start in the Academy interior facing the Headmaster.

## Why it is the best case

Maps stay reviewable as code and cannot drift from their validator; 10.2 says paths avoid wild patches so players control how often they fight.
